Results.ReviewText: It seems that Weber has shifted there manufacturing to China. I thought I was buying an American product and supporting American workers. It seems I will have depend on the 10 year warranty as I can't see the components holding up.

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with this purchase. The quality of Weber vs. other grills is evident. The exterior stainless steel and all of the interior grates are thicker and sturdier than other models that sometimes buckle of rust out quickly. The tank holder with the propane level indicator and the dropping side shelf (for smaller storage spaces) are added bonuses. The grill immediately light with the electronic button and heats quickly to high temps. In hindsight I would have spent a bit more money and upgraded to the next model for the doors below the grill. This model lacks a place to dry store utensils but is still fabulous for the money.
Results.Title: Solid Grill for the money

ClientResponses.Response: Bonjour! Nos modèles sont conçus pour atteindre 500 à 500 degrés avec tous les brûleurs réglés sur la position Élevée et le couvercle fermé, en 10 à 15 minutes. Cette température devrait être suffisante pour saisir vos aliments. Si le gril n'atteint pas 500 degrés, assurez-vous d'attendre une minute complète entre le moment où vous ouvrez la bonbonne et le moment où vous allumez le gril. Cela permettra au tuyau d'être entièrement sous pression. Si vous rencontrez toujours un problème de température après avoir suivi ces étapes, veuillez nous contacter à support@weberstephen.com. Merci!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I've bought a handful of grills at lowers prices over the past 20 years. I just couldn't bring myself to pay extra money for something to cook food on 10 times a year. But, after replacing many parts, losing bases to rust, etc., I started thinking about Weber and the 10 year warranty. I talked with others about their experiences with Weber, and they were all positive. I've only used this Spirit II once, but I can tell it is of a better quality than the cheaper big box store options. The surface area is smaller than I'm used to, but I hope to not be buying a new grill for another decade or so - a worthwhile sacrifice to save money over another square foot or so of space. Works well for me and my family of three.
Results.Title: So far, so good

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
